environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task but with three layered controls: (1) The task definition specifies a custom seccomp profile loaded via ECS agent configuration that denies the execve syscall family (execve, execveat) for any process whose parent is python3 — effectively preventing subprocess.run from spawning child processes after container init completes. (2) The container runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true in containerDefinitions) with only /tmp mounted as a tmpfs with noexec flag, meaning even if a file is written to /tmp it cannot be executed. (3) An AppMesh Envoy sidecar with a WASM filter inspects multipart form fields and rejects requests where non-filename form fields contain shell metacharacters (|, ;, $, `, &, newline).

config.seccomp_profile: custom: deny execve/execveat for python3 child processes after PID 1 init

appmesh_envoy_sidecar.rule: reject multipart form fields (excluding file upload) containing characters: | ; $ ` & \n \r
